description: This file contains assembly code for a MIPS architecture bootloader, specifically for an LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes startup routines, cache management, and relocation code.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point for the assembly startup routine, initializes CPU registers, cache, relocates code, clears BSS, and jumps to the main loader.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: Macro for executing a pipeline bubble (likely a no-operation wait) in MIPS assembly.
